text: APPROVE. The ternary and the extracted helper `AnnotatedArrowParameterClose` return the same `close` value as the old if/else in every case (the `;`/`{`/`}` break becomes `return -1`, the `:` after `)` match returns `k - 1`, and loop exhaustion returns -1), so behaviour is unchanged. Complexity is well under 15 in both methods, and I see nothing that would break the build: the helper uses only existing members, and the XML doc comment is well-formed.
